entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: One of five shards of Alara, black-aligned with blue and red as secondary colors, a world of death and undead dominated by demons and necromancers.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The plane that was sundered into five shards, one of which is Grixis.

entities.name: Vithia
entities.description: The white-aligned human empire that Grixis was before the Sundering, proud of its dynasty of honorable monarchs.

entities.name: Sedris
entities.description: Once the good king of Vithia who submitted to demons and became the most powerful lich warlord on Grixis.

entities.name: Sedraxis
entities.description: Once the shining capital of Vithia, now the largest necropolis on Grixis, ruled by Sedris.

entities.name: Sundering
entities.description: The event that split Alara into shards and cut Grixis off from white and green mana.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event in which the shards collided, flooding Grixis with white and green mana.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The great Dragon, a planeswalker, who had already disrupted the other shards.

entities.name: Nefarox
entities.description: Overlord of Grixis, the demon to whom the most notable cults are dedicated.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: The de facto leader of Grixis, whose death left chaos among factions.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian leader whose Machine Legion targeted Alara in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Vithians
entities.description: A group of humans on Grixis who actively hunt the undead and uphold the ways of a lost kingdom.

entities.name: Kathari
entities.description: A race of scavenging vulture-people who occupy the islands out to sea off Grixis.

entities.name: Torchlight
entities.description: A mountain fortress and the greatest hermitage of the living on Grixis.

entities.name: Dregscape
entities.description: A vast swamp of decaying corpses on Grixis, the kathari's feeding ground.

entities.name: Vis
entities.description: The life-force of living beings on Grixis, which empowers demons and fuels all of Grixis's magic.

events.summary: Sedris, king of Vithia, submits to demons' temptation, hands thousands of innocents over to them and becomes a lich; the paladins flee and Vithia is overrun.
events.quote: Sedris handed thousands of innocents over to the demons, killed his own family and advisors

events.summary: Grixis is cut off from white and green mana by the Sundering, and demons, witches and necromancers gain power while angels go extinct.
Vithia's capital is transformed into the greatest necropolis on the plane, still ruled by Sedris.
events.quote: Sedris still rules this dark city of the dead, as the most powerful lich warlord on the plane.

events.summary: The Conflux floods Grixis with life energies; the undead invade nearby planes.
events.quote: the life energies of green and white mana flooded into Grixis

events.summary: Grixis becomes part of the New Alara, demon cults rise, and after Malfegor dies chaos reigns among factions.
events.quote: After the death of the plane's de facto leader, Malfegor , chaos reigns

events.summary: Elesh Norn's Machine Legion strikes Alara in the New Phyrexian Invasion; the Maelstrom awakens to defend it.
events.quote: the Maelstrom itself awoke to fight on behalf of Alara

relations.note: One of the five shards of Alara.
relations.quote: is one of five shards of Alara

relations.note: Rules the necropolis as lich king.
relations.quote: The lich king Sedris rules this place

relations.note: Vithians actively hunt the undead of Grixis.
relations.quote: a group of humans called the Vithians actively hunt the undead
